Fantastic view, but very average food
Aug 2014 • Couples
Based on our experience there are far better options when it comes to eating in Nha Trang and they will be a lot cheaper than Paradise.
We were staying at Amiana Resort next door and thought we’d go here for a change because it was a 2 minute walk.
The prices at Amiana Restaurant are really reasonable for a 5 star resort and it looks like the owners of THIS place have had a look at next door’s menu because the prices here are very similar i.e. higher than the prices that you’ll find in the middle of town.

The two things that will amaze you immediately about Paradise are the size of this place(it’s ENORMOUS)and the view, which is spectacular.
I can’t trade that off against a bad meal though.
Prawns that were “chewy” and the main course of fish had been overcooked and was “mushy”.
This was a slow night with only another 3 tables occupied, all on the lower level.
In addition to average food we had to constantly look for our Vietnamese staff to ask for something.

If you have any mobility issues then you won’t be able to make it to the lower levels.

There is a bit of forethought with this place with a very large inflatable pool on the lower level for kids.
Against the side wall, throughout the night, there were a couple of live concert DVD’s that played, with a good sound system that was just loud enough. 
There’s also a lot of space set aside for the spa that operates on these premises.

Typical of the big places in this city there’s an in house Russian hostess, so the couple of Russian tables got well looked after.

I've spent a lot of time in Vietnam and this meal is very much at the lower end of what I've experienced.
